comment: Verifies the remote-image pipeline inside a real host: the fixture thread's must render as the blocked-by-default 'Show images' banner (strict-CSP hosts like claude.ai block remote img-src; we normalize all hosts to click-to-show). The interact step clicks the banner; .invalid never resolves, so the fetch fails identically offline and in open-egress CI and the banner deterministically re-renders as 'Retry'. Known limitation: 'Retry' also appears if the HOST rejects the app->server call before it reaches gmail_inbox.fetch_image, so this asserts the UI state machine, not the server fetch itself - the successful-fetch round-trip is pinned by HtmlEmailBody.test.tsx (mocked tool) and tests/test_image_proxy.py (server), and was verified live via expect_selectors with an allowlisted image host.
